name: @gemma/expression-analysis
description: Shared gene-expression browse (gene/GO-term picker + heatmap) and differential-expression browse (analyses, contrasts, p-value distributions, TSV download) panels. Consumed by apps/browser (public dataset page Visualize + Differential Expression tabs) and apps/curation (experiment Gene expression + Differential expression tabs). Presentation + orchestration only — each app supplies its own API functions (see the *Api interfaces in src/types.ts and src/deTypes.ts) so the package never assumes a transport or wire casing.
